33.name: Shadowfang Keep
33.lore: Archmage Arugal's keep above Pyrewood Village in Silverpine Forest. Arugal summoned the worgen to fight the Scourge for Gilneas and lost control of them; the keep is now theirs, and his ghost still walks its halls.

34.name: The Stockade
34.lore: Stormwind's prison beneath the city streets. The Defias Brotherhood has rioted inside it, and Bazil Thredd holds the deepest cell block.

35.name: Stormwind Vault
35.lore: A sealed vault deep beneath Stormwind City, walled off from the Stockade and kept closed against intruders.

36.name: The Deadmines
36.lore: The Defias Brotherhood's hidden base in a flooded Westfall mine. Edwin VanCleef's ship, the Defias destroyer, was built in its caverns.

43.name: Wailing Caverns
43.lore: Naralex's dream-caverns beneath the Barrens. His sleep to restore the Barrens went wrong, and the Druids of the Fang now serve the nightmare inside.

47.name: Razorfen Kraul
47.lore: Quilboar warrens in the southern Barrens ruled by Charlga Razorflank, who bargained with the Scourge for power over her own people.

48.name: Blackfathom Deeps
48.lore: Ancient ruins of Elune on the Darkshore coast, flooded and sunken. Twilight's Hammer and naga occupy the old temple above the buried horror Aku'mai.

70.name: Uldaman
70.lore: A titan-forged vault beneath the Badlands, contested by troggs and the Earthen. The Discs of Norgannon rest in its deepest chamber.

90.name: Gnomeregan
90.lore: The irradiated gnome capital beneath Dun Morogh, lost to Sicco Thermaplugg's betrayal and the trogg invasion.

109.name: Sunken Temple
109.lore: The Temple of Atal'Hakkar in the Swamp of Sorrows, dragged beneath the marsh with the green dragon Eranikus and the avatar of Hakkar inside.

129.name: Razorfen Downs
129.lore: The deeper quilboar barrow beneath Razorfen, given over to the Cult of the Damned and Amnennar the Coldbringer.

189.name: Scarlet Monastery
189.lore: The Scarlet Crusade's walled abbey in Tirisfal Glades, with its graveyard, library, armoury and cathedral wings.

209.name: Zul'Farrak
209.lore: A sandfury troll city in the dunes of Tanaris, where Chief Ukorz Sandscalp guards the ancient god Gahz'rilla.

229.name: Blackrock Spire
229.lore: The orcish fortress-spire above Blackrock Depths. Rend Blackhand holds the upper halls while Nefarian's servants rule the peak.

230.name: Blackrock Depths
230.lore: A Dark Iron city inside Blackrock Mountain, ruled by Emperor Dagran Thaurissan. The Molten Core burns beneath it.

249.name: Onyxia's Lair
249.lore: The black dragon Onyxia's lair in the Wyrmbog of Dustwallow Marsh, where she brooded after years spent ruling Stormwind in human guise.

269.name: The Black Morass
269.lore: The Caverns of Time's window onto the Black Morass, where the Dark Portal's opening is watched over by the bronze flight and their keepers.

289.name: Scholomance
289.lore: The School of Necromancy beneath Caer Darrow in the Western Plaguelands, where the Cult of the Damned trains its necromancers and keeps Kel'Thuzad's relics.

309.name: Zul'Gurub
309.lore: The jungle troll city of the Gurubashi in Stranglethorn Vale, where the priests summoned Hakkar the Soulflayer into the world.

329.name: Stratholme
329.lore: The Scourge-ruined city in the Eastern Plaguelands. The living Scarlet Crusade holds the bastion while Baron Rivendare commands the dead side.

349.name: Maraudon
349.lore: The caverns of the centaur princess Theradras in Desolace, grown over the tomb of Zaetar and the corrupted grove around it.

389.name: Ragefire Chasm
389.lore: Volcanic caverns beneath Orgrimmar, used as a haven by the Searing Blade cult and the burning legion's agents.

409.name: Molten Core
409.lore: The fire-lord Ragnaros's domain deep inside Blackrock Mountain, reached through the Blackrock Depths.

429.name: Dire Maul
429.lore: The ruined highborne city of Eldre'Thalas in Feralas, split between its east, west and north wings and the ghosts of its old aristocracy.

469.name: Blackwing Lair
469.lore: Nefarian's laboratory at the peak of Blackrock Spire, where he experiments on the dragonflights' eggs.

509.name: Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj
509.lore: The outer silithid ruins in Silithus, guarded by the anubisath and the qiraji general Ossirian.

531.name: Ahn'Qiraj Temple
531.lore: The qiraji temple-city of C'Thun, opened once the Gates of Ahn'Qiraj were unsealed.

532.name: Lower Karazhan Halls
532.lore: The lower halls of Medivh's tower in Deadwind Pass, opened on Turtle WoW as a raid through the tower's haunted foundations.

533.name: Naxxramas
533.lore: Kel'Thuzad's necropolis, hovering above the Plaguelands and packed with the Scourge's military elite.

800.name: Karazhan Crypt
800.lore: The flooded crypt beneath Karazhan, filling the halls of the tower's dead that were never finished in the original game.
